coverage_definition.state_aid: A state counts only when current official state aid programs are normalized and source-verified.
coverage_definition.institution: An institution counts only when identity plus at least one current policy domain is persisted and source-verified.
coverage_definition.complete_institution: Costs, admissions, merit, credit/transfer and appeal policy domains are all current or explicitly not applicable.

notes: This file starts counts at zero intentionally. Prior conversational research is not counted until it is persisted and source-verified in this repository.
Counts will be updated only from durable repository data.
